ByteLength.description: Canonical uint64 byte length. Range requires semantic validation.

applications.description: Actual pushes when preserving common ancestors between consecutive draws.

placementCommands.description: All supplied clip path commands checked during device placement.

capturedBytes.description: Exact packed pixel bytes copied for all snapshots; not process RSS.

effectiveF32Bits.description: Effective IEEE754 binary32 design coordinate. Rounding is explicit.

EllipticGradientWork.description: Maximum across elliptic fields; excludes pixel coverage and shader inverse arithmetic.

coordinateErrorBound.description:
Conservative device Q32 displacement of corresponding ellipse-family
points from parameter/plane conversion, including the tile phase budget.

encodedRootIntervalBound.description:
Q32 width of a successful solver enclosure for the encoded binary32
field. Not a bound on the source field's scalar or on pixel color.

parameterErrorBounds.description:
Dimensionless Q32 source uncertainty plus binary32 conversion error,
ordered scaleX/Y, centerX/Y, radiusX/Y.

oneOf.description:
Physical cell formatting. Covered cells remain queryable; page painting
selects merge origins separately.

A real table-style declaration instantiated by this native table. None
selects tblBg. Also identifies the exact lazy phClr reference context.

FixedQ32.description: Signed i128 integer divided by 2^32. Coordinate unit is specified by the owning geometry profile; semantic range validation required.

style.description: Index in the actual ManifestParagraphInput.styles, not a native run id.

horizontalOverflowLines.description: Counts the actual line search decisions, without rounding to integer EMU.

inkBounds.description: Unpainted glyph ink, including overhang; not a clipping/overlap verdict.

inner.description: Q32 EMU before page/group/animation placement. Insets are already applied.

maximumLeftExcess.description: Largest pen excursion beyond each line's own width (indent/margins apply).

verticalExcess.description: max(content_height - inner height, 0), before vertical anchoring.

GeometryOrigin.description:
Ordinals are zero-based element preorder in the indicated XML resource.
Preset ordinals address the pinned, generated catalog definition, not the
document part. A document override always retains its physical source.

oneOf.description: Native table-style font collection; stored in the table style catalog.

authoredFont.description: Original selected font declaration; absent for a fontRef fallback.

tableFont.description: Script/collection location for an explicit table a:font declaration.

themeFont.description: Selected named theme font preserves its own metadata, independently of author hints.

peakPixelBytes.description: Peak simultaneously live intermediate pixels, excluding output/snapshots.

pixelWork.description: Pixels cleared plus pixels composited, including fully transparent groups.

frameSha256.description: SHA-256 of the little-endian device batch; use together with profile.

coordinateErrorBound.description:
Conservative maximum error of the transformed control coordinates,
measured in raw Q32 pixels. Not a raster coverage error bound.

ellipticGradients.description: Only present for V12 ellipse fields. Geometry and solver errors are separate.

gradientCoordinateErrorBound.description: Device geometry input quantization, not a bound on shader evaluation or pixels.

gradientValueErrorBound.description:
Maximum stop/color conversion or linear/rectangular field error.
Elliptic parameter and root bounds are reported separately.

miterLimitErrorBound.description: Dimensionless raw Q32; not added to pixel coordinate budgets.

strokeWidthErrorBound.description: Width quantization, in raw Q32 pixels; not an ink boundary error bound.

combinedCoordinateErrorBound.description: Transform + final device quantization, raw Q32 pixels.

loweringAttempts.description:
2 means the shared matrix candidate failed numeric/precision checks and
lowering used the original node chain before any backend call.

pointTransformWork.description: Conservative point/node work per attempt, including identity instances.

transformErrorBound.description: Quantization/composition error bound, raw Q32 document units (EMU).

uses.description:
Every source binding sharing the failed computation style, including
insertion style (run=None), with native declaration/theme provenance.

imageClipCoordinateErrorBound.description:
Upstream image fill-rectangle clip error in Q32 device pixels, before
shared scene lowering. Image brush uncertainty is accounted downstream.

pathCoordinateErrorBound.description:
Relative to evaluated binary64 guide values. Does not bound upstream
guide evaluation, coverage, color or application compatibility.

oneOf.description: Missing relationship or matching placeholder; no synthetic geometry.
Slide idx=0xffffffff is explicitly detached from layout matching.

textCapacity.description: Missing in historical responses; absence never means measured to fit.

supplemental.description: Index into the table font collection's ordered supplemental list.

frames.description: Complete frame coverage in paint order, including empty text frames.

value.description: None means unavailable; nonpositive thickness is an unusable metric.

TextStyleDeclaration.description:
Selected whole declaration. Consumers must still resolve its native semantics,
retained descendants, colors, theme fonts, resources, effects and permissions.
The reference is meaningful only with this result's immutable SourceIndex.

supplemental.description: Index into the original ordered supplemental list, not a physical ordinal.
